name: Dingavis
sum: Long-snouted ornithuromorph from the Jiufotang Formation at Sihedang, Liaoning.
holotype: An almost complete skeleton with skull on a plate, with neck feathers, acquired by the IVPP (number in O'Connor et al. 2016).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: O'Connor et al. 2016

sources.text: O'Connor, J.K.; Wang, M.; Hu, H. 2016. A new ornithuromorph (Aves) with an elongate rostrum from the Jehol Biota, and the early evolution of rostralization in birds. Journal of Systematic Palaeontology 14(11): 939–948. doi:10.1080/14772019.2015.1129518

Huang, J.; Wang, X.; Hu, Y.; Liu, J.; Peteya, J.A.; Clarke, J.A. 2016. A new ornithurine from the Early Cretaceous of China sheds light on the evolution of early ecological and cranial diversity in birds. PeerJ 4. doi:10.7717/peerj.1765
